faq: Do I have to buy a paid theme?
No. BigCommerce has free themes that work well, and we can tailor one of those. If you prefer a paid one from the theme store, you buy it and we customize it for you.
Is this different from theme edits?
Yes. This is for stores starting with a stock theme and wanting a branded result. Theme edits suit stores that already have a theme and need fixes or changes to it.
Can I keep editing the theme myself?
Yes. We use the standard theme editor wherever possible and add a short guide, so you can change text, images and banners later without breaking the layout.
Will the theme work on mobile?
Yes. We check the finished store on phone and tablet sizes and fix spacing and tap targets before handover.

desc:
BigCommerce theme customization starts with choosing a proven theme and then tailoring it to your brand. Ecom Swift LLC helps you pick one that fits your products, then applies your logo, colors, fonts, layout and custom sections so it feels like your own store.

## What is BigCommerce theme customization?

BigCommerce theme customization means taking a ready-made theme, free or paid, and adapting it to your brand and your range. We set your logo, colors and fonts, arrange the home page, style product and category pages and add sections that suit what you sell.

It sits between using a theme exactly as it ships and commissioning a one-off design. You keep the reliability of a tested theme while the store stops looking like everyone else's.

## Why theme choice matters before any styling

A theme sets the structure of your store: how menus work, how products are displayed and which sections you can add. Pick one that does not suit your range, and you fight it forever. A theme built around large photography will frustrate a store with hundreds of small items, and a dense catalog theme will undersell a few hero products.

Starting from a well-matched theme saves work, keeps pages light and makes later edits easier. Choosing carefully at the beginning is cheaper than switching later.

## How a tailored theme helps your store

Shoppers should recognize your brand from the first screen and find what they want quickly. Consistent colors, fonts and buttons build trust. A home page that shows your best sellers and clear categories moves people toward products instead of leaving them to search.

Navigation and page styling also guide behavior: a well-built menu helps people browse, and a tidy product page puts price and the buy button where eyes expect them. Mobile layout matters most, since many shoppers browse on phones. Outcomes depend on your products and traffic, so we describe the design improvements without promising a sales figure.

## What a well-tailored theme includes

- A shortlist of suitable themes with reasons for each.
- Your logo, favicon and social sharing image set up.
- Brand colors and fonts applied across the whole store.
- A home page arranged around your best sellers and main categories.
- Custom sections such as featured collections, brand story or benefits.
- Styling for product and category pages.
- A navigation menu built around how shoppers browse.
- A footer with a newsletter block.
- Extra page layouts in the larger packages.
- A mobile polish pass and a short guide to editing it yourself.

## How we do it

First we ask about your products, your customers and the stores you admire. From that, we prepare a shortlist of themes and explain how each one fits. You choose, or we recommend one and say why.

We then apply your branding, build the home page and style the key pages. You receive a preview link before anything is public. The Basic package covers the theme choice and core branding. Standard adds custom home sections, page styling, a menu and a footer. Premium adds more sections, extra layouts, a mobile polish pass and a short video guide to editing. This work focuses on appearance, while code-level fixes belong to the theme edits service.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Pick a theme for how your products are shown, not only for how its demo looks.
- Gather your logo, brand colors and best photos in advance.
- Keep fonts and colors to a small, consistent set.
- Open the preview link on a real phone before approving.
- Ask for the editing guide, so you can make small updates yourself.

**Avoid:**
- Choosing a theme only because the demo photos are attractive.
- Mixing many fonts and accent colors.
- Overloading the home page with sliders and banners.
- Paying for a premium theme before checking free options.
- Editing code yourself without a copy of the theme.

## Who this is for

This service suits a new seller who does not know where to start with design, an owner whose store still looks like the default theme, and a brand with strong photos and a clear identity that wants them shown properly.

## What we need from you

A short description of your products and style, your logo and brand colors if you have them, and a few stores you like. We never need your password. You add us as a staff user with permissions for theme and content work, and you tell us whether you already own a paid theme or want us to recommend one.
